name: zzbd_manager_sort_section_handlers
description: zZbdManager::SortSectionHandlers orders the manager's registered section handlers by ascending signed sortOrder while preserving the linked-list ring and handler count.
known_limits: Binary Ninja shows the original body as an MSVC 5.0 STL std::list::sort cascade. Production source models the cascade over the recovered zZbdSectionHandlerList helper methods instead of compiling provider STL directly.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zUtil ZBD/ZAR manager helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c07d0 validates the caller contract: no-op for fewer than two handlers, otherwise sort all nodes from sectionHandlerListSentinel in ascending zZbdSectionHandler::CompareSortOrderLessThan order before LoadEntries walks the list.
The native smoke registers out-of-order handlers, calls SortSectionHandlers, and verifies the resulting linked-list order, count, tail, and sentinel links.
